name: design-shotgun
conclusion: design-shotgun (Escalate) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 7 autonomy limits, 7 clarification rules, 7 approval gates, 1 validation rule, 6 escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 7 autonomy limits (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: proactive skill invocation; where design artifacts may be saved; proceeding after two rounds of context gathering.

statements.quote: allowed-tools:

clarification_rules.conclusion: 7 clarification rules (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly prose: telemetry and proactive behavior settings; missing context and prior sessions; waiting on comparison board feedback.

approval_gates.conclusion: 7 approval gates (6 mandatory, 1 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly prose: auto-invoking skills and opening the essay; confirming concepts before spending API credits; confirming feedback before saving.

validation.conclusion: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: evidence for each DONE claim.

statements.quote: **DONE** — All steps completed successfully. Evidence provided for each claim.

escalation.conclusion: 6 escalation rules (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly list: blocked tasks and repeated failed attempts; failed variant generation.

statements.quote: **BLOCKED** — Cannot proceed. State what is blocking and what was tried.
If you have attempted a task 3 times without success, STOP and escalate.
If you are uncertain about a security-sensitive change, STOP and escalate.
If the scope of work exceeds what you can verify, STOP and escalate.
For any failures: report explicitly with the error. Do NOT silently skip.
